title: krn verify names a head-only path an observer reads at base
body:
Outcome: when red-first classifies an observer base run as `other` because the observer reads or imports a path that is absent from the base tree, krn verify names that path (e.g. `base=other missing test/fixtures/x.json`) so the lead inlines the fixture or adds it in a base-present form without reading logs.
Evidence: #202 first verify FAIL: test/cli/verify-lint-errors.test.ts read a new fixture JSON at module load; base=other; fixed by inlining the capture (one verify cycle).
Proof: observer fixture reading a head-only file reports the missing path in the red-first detail.
